description: Provides a set of WireframeComponentDef entries to the WireframeComponentRegistry. Built-in Tempo.Blazor components are registered via BuiltInWireframeComponentProvider (priority 0). Custom components are added by implementing this interface and calling services.AddWireframeComponentProvider<T>() in Program.cs. When two providers register the same Type, the one with the higher Priority wins. Note: for pure metadata (no Blazor rendering dependency), use IWireframeSchemaSource / WireframeSchemaRegistry instead — those live in Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions and are safe for API/MCP server projects.

methods.name: ProviderId
methods.description: Unique identifier for this provider (used in logging and override detection).

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Higher priority wins when multiple providers register the same component type. Built-in uses 0; set > 0 to override.

methods.name: GetDefinitions
methods.description: Returns all component definitions supplied by this provider.
